title: Polonnaruwa, Pothuvil record 37.5°C as heat intensifies
byline: Polonnaruwa and Pothuvil recorded the highest maximum temperature in the country today (23), with temperatures reaching 37.5°C, the Meteorology said.

title: PHIs to launch island-wide trade union action tomorrow
byline: The Sri Lanka Public Health Inspectors Association (PHIA) is set to launch an island-wide trade union action from tomorrow (24), citing the failure of health authorities to address concerns over the transfer of Public Health Inspector B.H. Migasdeniya.

title: Five killed in road accidents in just 24 hours
byline: Sri Lanka’s roads claimed five lives within a single 24-hour period, with a series of fatal accidents reported across the island yesterday (22), the Police Media Division said.

title: Australia confirms first H5N1 bird flu case in local mammal
byline: Australia on Sunday confirmed its first case of H5N1 bird flu in a mammal, with ​the deadly virus found in a long-nosed fur seal in South ‌Australia state.

title: 750 balls, two days: Mackay test makes history
byline: Australia’s victory at Mackay has gone into the record books as one of the shortest completed Tests, with the match lasting just 750 deliveries across two days.

title: Over 8,000 bottles of drinking water with fake SLS mark seized
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) has seized nearly 8,500 bottles of drinking water bearing a counterfeit Sri Lanka Standards (SLS) mark during a special raid in Avissawella.

title: Jaffna traders fined over Rs. 650,000 for overpricing goods
byline: Three businesses in Jaffna have been fined a total of Rs. 668,000 by the Jaffna Magistrate’s Court for selling goods above regulated or printed prices.

title: Iran condemns US plans to announce new sanctions
byline: Iran on Saturday denounced U.S. plans to announce new sanctions that could put further strain on the Islamic Republic’s economy and have an impact ​on its most important trading partners including China.

title: Two arrested with over 1,044kg of cannabis
byline: Two suspects have been arrested with more than 1,044 kilograms of cannabis during two separate raids in Gomagala.

title: New electric train project for Colombo suburbs to begin next year
byline: Work on a new electric train project covering Colombo and its suburbs is scheduled to begin next year, with initial planning already completed, Deputy Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government Ruwan Senarath said.

title: Man killed during dispute at Party in Kekirawa
byline: A 56-year-old man was killed following a dispute that broke out during a party at his residence in Kottalbadha, Kekirawa early this morning.

title: Hand grenade thrown at house in Borella
byline: A hand grenade was thrown at a house in 141 Watta on Leslie Ranagala Mawatha, Borella, in an apparent attack linked to an ongoing dispute between organized crime groups, police said.

title: Kandy prepares for first Randoli Perahera tonight
byline: Traffic movement in Kandy is expected to be disrupted this evening (23) as the first Randoli Perahera of the historic Kandy Esala Perahera takes to the streets at 6.44 p.m.

title: Canada to retaliate for US tariffs, worsening ties after talks fail
byline: Canada will impose tariffs on some U.S. goods in retaliation for 50% ​levies ordered by President Donald Trump on Canadian products, Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Saturday, after trade talks collapsed between the two neighbors.

title: 8-year-old girl dies in Walpola accident
byline: An 8-year-old girl has died following a tragic multi-vehicle accident near the Walpola railway crossing on the Ragama–Kandana road on Saturday (August 22).

title: Panama-flagged cargo ship sinks off Odisha coast, 2 survivors rescued, 22 missing
byline: A Panama-flagged bulk carrier carrying 24 crew members sank in the Bay of Bengal, around 240 nautical miles from Odisha’s Paradip coast, on Saturday, triggering a major search-and-rescue operation by the Indian Coast Guard (ICG) and Indian Navy.

title: Chinese robots beat Usain Bolt’s 100m world record at Beijing games
byline: A Chinese ‌humanoid robot ran 100 metres in 9.39 seconds in a preliminary heat at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing on Saturday, faster than the men’s world record held by Jamaican sprinting great Usain Bolt.
